authorial_core.interpreted_intent: Requester asks for a surreal level 3 test within the ongoing independently randomized portrait-reference experiment. Independent alternatives compared an impossible receding doorway and a person standing beneath an arch; the inverted support relationship has a more immediate full-frame contradiction, subject presence and observable sole contact. The arcade, clothing and bodily arrangement are authorial choices, not requester facts. One impossible support relationship must lead the image; the readable ordinary street prevents a mere upside-down-camera interpretation. Preserve only visible face and short dark bob/fringe cues from the supplied reference, without inferring identity, age or personality. Subtle attraction comes from close attentive expression and light, with sensual 1, fetish 0, creativity 1 and surreal 3.
authorial_core.subject: A reference-guided woman in an inverted standing arrangement beneath a brick arch
authorial_core.setting: Sunlit brick arcade above an ordinary upright street
authorial_core.event: The woman stands with both soles attached to overhead masonry while her body extends downward
visual_priorities: Both feet and the inverted body form one clearly legible support chain under the arch
The ordinary upright street conflicts visibly with her inverted standing position
The reference face and bob remain recognizable at the chosen full-body projection
authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A surreal photographic scene led by an impossible support relationship. A woman resembling the supplied portrait stands upside down on the curved underside of a brick arcade: both shoe soles rest flush against the overhead masonry, her straight legs descend from those contacts toward her inverted torso, and her head hangs below her shoulders toward the ordinary street. This departure from ordinary gravity dominates the entire photograph. Frame her near the mouth of the arcade, large enough to recognize her face, with the arch sweeping across the top and a strip of upright street below. The lower street contains a vertical black lamppost, a pavement curb and the base of the opposite building, clearly establishing the ordinary world's upright direction. Her two feet occupy neighboring bricks on one shallow section of the arch, separated by a natural hip-width stance; the contact edges and both shoes remain visible against the pale mortar. Her body continues in one unbroken anatomical chain below them, arms relaxed beside her torso and hands open. Her dark bob falls gently toward the street, individual short strands and wispy fringe outlining her inverted face. Preserve the reference's visible facial proportions and dark eyes, with her face turned slightly toward the camera, an attentive gaze and a faint almost amused smile. She wears charcoal straight-leg trousers, simple black flat shoes and a soft ivory blouse whose loose hem hangs toward the street. The quiet closeness of her expression provides a subtle human attraction within the disorienting space. Use a portrait photograph from an upright camera on the arcade floor, a medium-wide lens and a nearly frontal view that keeps both sole-to-brick contacts, her face and the street's vertical markers simultaneously clear. Soft late-afternoon side light picks out brick texture and a warm contour along her cheek, with natural pores, believable fabric weight and crisp contact shadows. The entire composition turns around the contradiction between her inverted standing position and the normal street below.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: Use the explicitly selected surreal level 3 so an impossible relationship leads the whole photograph; agent staging remains replaceable.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Sexual attraction or arousal focused on particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities that carry special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This focus leads the image's appeal and direction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request, including the depth of candidate-informed reconstruction after the independent baseline is frozen. It changes exploration and authorial reconstruction, not requester ownership or candidate-adoption quotas.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image. After retrieval, retain candidate-informed changes only when needed for faithful meaning, legibility or consistency; do not expand the scene merely to use material.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction. After retrieval, consider local additions, replacements or subtractions with a concrete expressive benefit, keeping the overall direction close to the request.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction. After retrieval, develop candidate-informed alternatives that reorganize connected authorial choices, including replacement and subtraction rather than only local additions.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving every requester requirement. After retrieval, actively develop whole-photograph reconstructions from that required meaning and compatible candidate material, substantially replacing agent-authored staging when it serves the requested freedom. Do not limit exploration to fixing the baseline or prescribe a minimum adoption count or rewrite percentage.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

levels.0: No added surreal treatment; preserve explicitly requested fantasy and impossible elements.
levels.1: Surreal qualities are a subtle supporting presence.
levels.2: Surreal qualities are clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: Surreal qualities lead the image's main impression and direction; a single coherent relationship may carry this prominence.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.

emphasis_resolution.reason: Effective sensual=1, fetish=0; the higher intensity leads.
